name: Puig Major Loop
description: The big Tramuntana day: 137 km over the island's highest road via Sóller and the Puig Major tunnel climb, with Sa Calobra country all around.

name: Sóller, Deià and Port de Valldemossa Loop
description: The Tramuntana coast at its most beautiful: Sóller, the corniche road through Deià, and the dramatic drop to Port de Valldemossa. 61 km that punches well above its distance.

name: Coll de Femenia – Sa Batalla Loop
description: The classic Pollença mountain loop: up Coll de Femenia towards Lluc and back over Sa Batalla, with the famous petrol-station café stop. A staple of every Mallorca training week.

name: Bay of Pollensa Loop
description: Rolling 75 km loop around the Bay of Pollensa with the option of the Cap Formentor lighthouse road — the north of the island's signature riding.

name: Best of Mallorca 312: Capdella – Galilea – Puigpunyent
description: The prettiest section of the Mallorca 312 sportive as a 61 km loop: Capdella, the balcony village of Galilea and the Puigpunyent valley in the south-west Tramuntana.

name: Andratx to Port Pollença — Tramuntana Traverse
description: The full Serra de Tramuntana end to end: 162 km and over 4,000 m from Andratx to Port Pollença via Port des Canonge, Port Valldemossa and Sa Calobra. Mallorca's ultimate point-to-point.
